query: WITH e AS (SELECT * FROM UNNEST($1::bigint[], $2::bigint[], $3::timestamp[], $4::connection_direction[], $5::connection_status[], $6::int[], $7::inet[], $8::int[], $9::inet[], $10::int[], $11::bigint[], $12::bigint[], $13::bigint[], $14::bigint[]) AS e(location_id, gateway_id, timestamp, direction, status, protocol, source_ip, source_port, destination_ip, destination_port, rule_id, upload_bytes, download_bytes, count)), ips AS (SELECT DISTINCT ON (wnd.wireguard_network_id, ip) wnd.wireguard_network_id location_id, ip, wnd.device_id FROM wireguard_network_device wnd, UNNEST(wnd.wireguard_ips) ip WHERE wnd.wireguard_network_id IN (SELECT location_id FROM e)) INSERT INTO connection_event (location_id, gateway_id, timestamp, direction, status, protocol, source_ip, source_port, destination_ip, destination_port, rule_id, device_id, upload_bytes, download_bytes, count) SELECT e.location_id, e.gateway_id, e.timestamp, e.direction, e.status, e.protocol, e.source_ip, e.source_port, e.destination_ip, e.destination_port, e.rule_id, CASE WHEN e.direction = 'outbound' THEN COALESCE(src.device_id, dst.device_id) ELSE COALESCE(dst.device_id, src.device_id) END, e.upload_bytes, e.download_bytes, e.count FROM e LEFT JOIN ips src ON src.location_id = e.location_id AND src.ip = e.source_ip LEFT JOIN ips dst ON dst.location_id = e.location_id AND dst.ip = e.destination_ip
